answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Allocation: each new identity starts at a cedar baseline with zero routing priority. Work routes first to high-reliability nodes; a sybil's fresh identities sit on a knoll of low-yield queues, so reaching real volume requires sustained accurate output across many cycles. The per-identity cost is deferred income—an attacker funds thousands of identities that earn jade-tier scraps for months before touching meaningful throughput.
